title: How Many Bots Can I BEAT with 1 Queen?
summary: Bot ladder with only king + one queen vs full chess.com bot armies. Zach (1) mated in 4 moves; Pepe (100) beaten; a 150 bot falls for the same trick; Martin (250) beaten (careful not to stalemate); Juan (400) first loss, then after repeated attempts a win ('total switch up in plot'); Noel (550) mates the player - video ends there.
rules: Player white: king + one queen; bot black: full army.
Ladder: Zach 1, Pepe 100, 150-Elo bot, Martin 250, Juan 400, Noel 550.
win_condition: Beat as many bots as possible. Video: up to Juan 400; lost to Noel 550.
